description: Source code for the FormulasPane class, which is a GUI component for displaying and updating engine formulas and sensor data visualization in a Java application.

classes.name: FormulasPane
classes.description: A GUI panel for displaying engine formulas, sensor data, and mathematical formulas using LaTeX rendering, with controls for pausing updates and saving images.

methods.name: FormulasPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI components, setting up timers, and event handlers.

methods.name: updateFormula
methods.description: Updates the displayed formula based on current sensor data and engine configuration.

methods.name: getAccelerationVariables
methods.description: Generates LaTeX-formatted strings for acceleration-related variables.

methods.name: getSpeedDensity
methods.description: Generates LaTeX-formatted string for speed density mode calculations.

methods.name: getInjecctorLag
methods.description: Returns LaTeX string for injector lag based on battery voltage.

methods.name: oneDecimal
methods.description: Formats a sensor value as a one-decimal string.

methods.name: twoDecimals
methods.description: Formats a sensor value as a two-decimal string.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel content of the FormulasPane.
